validated_results.title: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and risk of cancer: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.
validated_results.reason: This is an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies pooling risk estimates, not an original human study.

validated_results.title: Clinical utility of genetic variants of glutamate carboxypeptidase II in predicting breast cancer and prostate cancer risk.
validated_results.reason: The report models genetic variants of glutamate carboxypeptidase II and gene expression for cancer risk prediction, with folate mentioned only as a correlate and no population-wide folic acid exposure estimate.

validated_results.title: Flavokawain A induces deNEDDylation and Skp2 degradation leading to inhibition of tumorigenesis and cancer progression in the TRAMP transgenic mouse model.
validated_results.reason: Flavokawain A was tested exclusively in cell lines and TRAMP transgenic mice, so the evidence is entirely preclinical.

validated_results.title: Methylseleninic Acid Superactivates p53-Senescence Cancer Progression Barrier in Prostate Lesions of Pten-Knockout Mouse.
validated_results.reason: Methylseleninic acid efficacy was evaluated only in Pten-knockout mouse prostate lesions, an exclusively preclinical model.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D, PTH, and calcium and tumor aggressiveness in prostate cancer: a prospective nested case-control study.
validated_results.reason: Prospective nested case-control study within a diet and cancer cohort relating pre-diagnostic serum calcium to incident prostate cancer risk.

cases.excerpt: We performed a nested case-control study within the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study on 943 incident prostate cancer cases.
